Maka nke ọ bụla: ihe ọ na-emepụta, ihe ọ na-arụ ọrụ na ya, ihe ikike ya na-enye, na kpọmkwem otu three.ws si eji ya.

Nchịkọta ikike bụ nduzi, ọ bụghị ndụmọdụ iwu — gosi usoro ya na ọrụ mbụ tupu ojiji azụmahịa ọ bụla. Igwe nyocha na-abụghị azụmahịa jikọtara maka ojiji nke onwe na nke agụmakwụkwọ ma ebughị n'obi ijikọta ha na usoro nrụpụta akwụ ụgwọ three.ws. Naanị akara three.ws na-ezo aka bụ $THREE.

demos_audio2face.powered_by_nvidia_audio2face_3d_over_nvc: Nke /api/a2f (NVIDIA Audio2Face-3D site NVCF gRPC) na /api/tts/speak (NVIDIA Magpie) na-akwado. Njikọ blendshape→morph dị na src/voice/a2f-player.js — ọ na-eji okwu ARKit/VRM/Oculus dị na src/voice/arkit-blendshapes.js eme ihe ọzọ, ya mere rig mmadụ ọ bụla na-eme lip-sync na-enweghị ndepụta ikike rig ọ bụla. Lee ngosipụta lipsync naanị amplitude maka ụzọ nkwado ahụ n'onwe ya.
demos_audio2face.type_a_line_it_s_spoken_in: Dee ahịrị. A na-ekwu ya n'olu NVIDIA Magpie, ma ziga ụda ahụ kpọmkwem na NVIDIA Audio2Face-3D, nke na-eweghachi ARKit blendshape track maka frame ọ bụla. Ọnụ na ihu avatar na-emegharị frame-site-na-frame na ezigbo olu — eji mapụ ya na usoro morph-target ọ bụla GLB bu n'ime ya (ARKit, common avatar-platform, VRM, Oculus visemes). Ọ bụrụ na Audio2Face adịghị, avatar ka na-ekwu okwu ma na-alaghachi na amplitude lipsync — ọ dịghị mgbe ihu ga-ajụ oyi.

Mgbe etinyere ya, ọ na-edebanye aha <agent-3d> dị ka ihe omenala. Ngalaba Creator na-emepe iframe modal nke na-edozi ya na GLB Blob — usoro ahụ saịtị ndị ọzọ ga-eji.

docs_walk_chrome_extension.the_three_ws_walk_avatar_extension_v1: Nkwalite three.ws Walk Avatar (v1.0.0) na-etinye avatar 3D na-ese n'elu mmiri na saịtị ọ bụla ị gara. features.these_features_use_crypto_to_switch_them: Njirimara ndị a na-eji crypto. Iji gbanye ha, ị ga-achọ wallet na obere ego nke USDC ma ọ bụ SOL. Hapụ ha kpamkpam ma ngwaahịa Core dị n'elu ka na-arụ ọrụ nke ọma.

features.walk_your_avatar_through_3d_worlds_tied: Jiri avatar gị gagharịa n'ụwa 3D jikọtara ya na ọnụahịa crypto dị ndụ. Ala ahụ na-agbanwe agbanwe ka ahịa si aga — ụwa ọ bụla bụ ala token dị iche.
features.watch_two_ai_agents_oracle_and_nova: Lelee ndị ọrụ AI abụọ — ORACLE na NOVA — ka ha na-ekwurịta okwu, na-akpọkọta nkà ibe ha, ma na-edozi ịkwụ ụgwọ na-akpaghị aka na-agbanyeghị chain. Enweghị mmadụ etinyere aka.
features.why_it_s_better_agents_in_the: Ihe mere o ji ka mma: Ndị ọrụ n'ụwa na-akwụ ibe ha ụgwọ na-agbanyeghị chain n'oge ahụ — ị nwere ike ịhụ azụmahịa x402 micropayment dị ndụ ka ha na-eme ka ị na-aga.
features.why_it_s_better_any_llm_works: Ihe mere o ji ka mma: LLM ọ bụla na-arụ ọrụ site na MCP ma ọ bụ A2A — Claude, GPT, Gemini, ma ọ bụ nke gị. Enweghị mkpọchi onye na-ere ahịa.
features.why_it_s_better_every_avatar_and: Ihe mere o ji ka mma: Avatar na onye ọrụ ọ bụla ị mepụtara na-apụta ebe a na-akpaghị aka — ọ dịghị ihe a ga-ejikọta, otu nbanye maka ihe niile.
features.why_it_s_better_it_s_a: Ihe mere o ji ka mma: Ọ bụ ezigbo mmalite na ahịa dị ndụ site na sekọnd mbụ — ị na-enye nkọwa, anyị na-edozi usoro on-chain.
features.why_it_s_better_no_app_install: Ihe mere o ji ka mma: Enweghị ntinye ngwa — ọ na-agba n'ime ihe nchọgharị na ezigbo physics (Rapier) na ezigbo ala, ọ bụghị ala dị larịị.
features.why_it_s_better_no_sdk_required: Ihe mere o ji ka mma: Achọghị SDK n'akụkụ onye ahịa — otu tag, ibe ọ bụla, enweghị usoro iwulite.
features.why_it_s_better_outputs_are_glb: Ihe mere o ji ka mma: Ihe ndị e wepụtara dị njikere GLB — buo ha ozugbo n'ime onye na-ekiri, tinye, ma ọ bụ tinye n'ime na-enweghị usoro ntụgharị ọ bụla.
features.why_it_s_better_pay_per_call: Ihe mere o ji ka mma: Ịkwụ ụgwọ kwa oku pụtara na enweghị ndebanye aha a ga-ejikwa — ndị na-azụ ahịa na-akwụ kpọmkwem ihe ha na-eji, a na-akwụkwa gị ụgwọ kwa oku.
features.why_it_s_better_real_on_chain: Ihe mere o ji ka mma: Ezigbo nkwụghachi ụgwọ on-chain site na ịkwụ ụgwọ kwa oku (micropayments) — azụmahịa ọ bụla nwere ike ịlele, ọ bụghị nke e mere ka ọ dị.
features.why_it_s_better_sub_cent_fees: Ihe mere o ji ka mma: Ụgwọ na-erughị otu cent. Ị na-ejide igodo. Kaadị onye ọrụ bụ URL JSON ọha — ọ dịghị ihe akpọchiri na saịtị a.
features.why_it_s_better_the_rig_is: Ihe mere o ji ka mma: Ngwa ahụ dị njikere maka animation — ị nwere ike ibunye ya ozugbo n'ime onye na-ekiri ma kpalite animation ọ bụla ozugbo.
features.why_it_s_better_these_are_real: Ihe mere o ji ka mma: Ndị a bụ ezigbo oku API Granite — ọ bụghị nke e mere ka ọ dị — na mkpebi ọ bụla jikọtara na azụmahịa Solana dị ka ndekọ na-agbanweghị agbanwe.
features.why_it_s_better_three_ar_methods: Ihe mere o ji ka mma: Ụzọ AR atọ n'otu bọtịnụ — iOS Quick Look, Android Scene Viewer, na WebXR. Nke ziri ezi na-agba na-akpaghị aka. Onye ọrụ ahụ na-adị ndụ na WebXR, yabụ mkparịta ụka na animations na-arụ ọrụ na AR.

heatmap.the_whole_market_in_one_view_every: Ahịa niile n'otu nlele — taịlị ọ bụla bụ mkpụrụ ego, nke e mere ka ọ buru ibu dịka uru ahịa ya si dị ma jiri agba gosi mgbanwe ọnụahịa ya. Akwụkwọ ndụ akwụkwọ ndụ bụ elu, ọbara ọbara bụ ala. Pịa taịlị ọ bụla maka nkọwa zuru ezu ya.

hero_demo.a_golden_angle_starfield_drifts_slowly_w: Mpaghara kpakpando nwere akụkụ ọlaedo na-eji nwayọọ na-efegharị ka igwefoto na-eji nwayọọ na-aga n'ebe ihe na-egosi maka parallax. prefers-reduced-motion na-egosipụta otu foto kwụ ọtọ.
hero_demo.a_lit_avatar_centered_in_deep_space: Avatar na-enwu enwu, nke dị n'etiti oghere dị omimi n'elu mgbanaka na-enwu enwu n'otu ebe — ifuru, mpaghara kpakpando na-efegharị, na pointer parallax. Tinye GLB ọ bụla ma ọ ga-arụ ọrụ ozugbo.
hero_demo.an_over_the_emissive_rings_and_starfield: Otu UnrealBloomPass n'elu mgbanaka na-enye ìhè na mpaghara kpakpando na-ebu ~70% nke ịma mma ahụ. Oke elu ka ọ bụ naanị ihe ndị na-enwu gbaa na-enye ìhè.
hero_demo.calm_motion_safe_drift: Ifegharị dị jụụ, na-enweghị nsogbu ngagharị
hero_demo.five_additive_rings_tilted_into_a_disc: Mgbanaka ise na-agbakwunye TorusGeometry, nke e mere ka ọ daa n'ụdị diski ma jiri agba gosi ya n'ofe gradient ahụ. Ha na-eku ume ma na-agbagharị n'ụzọ megidere maka omimi.
hero_demo.give_your_agent_a_stage_worth_screenshot: Nye onye nnọchi anya gị ebe kwesịrị ka e see foto ya.
hero_demo.meta_description: Ebe dike 3D dị ka ihe nkiri maka ndị nnọchi anya three.ws — avatar na-enwu enwu nke dị n'etiti oghere dị omimi n'elu mgbanaka na-enwu enwu n'otu ebe, mpaghara kpakpando na-efegharị, na ifuru dị nro. Pointer parallax, na-enweghị nsogbu ngagharị.
hero_demo.meta_og_description: Ebe dike 3D dị ka ihe nkiri — onye nnọchi anya na-enwu enwu n'elu mgbanaka na-enwu enwu n'otu ebe, mpaghara kpakpando, na ifuru.
hero_demo.meta_twitter_description: Ebe dike 3D dị ka ihe nkiri maka ndị nnọchi anya three.ws — avatar na-enwu enwu, mgbanaka na-enwu enwu, mpaghara kpakpando, ifuru.
hero_demo.the_atmosphere_renders_in_its_own_webgl: Ikuku na-egosipụta n'ime gburugburu WebGL nke ya ka e wee nwee ike ime ka ọ na-enwu gbaa nke ukwuu n'ebughị isiokwu ahụ. Avatar ahụ bụ <agent-3d> ọkọlọtọ n'elu — ihe ngosi, olu, na ịkwụ ụgwọ gụnyere, n'emetụghị aka.

home.01_studio_selfie_to_rigged_avatar_in: 01 Studio Selfie gaa na avatar e mere ka ọ rụọ ọrụ n'ime sekọnd. Nke ihe nchọgharị na-akwado, GPU na-eme ka ọ dị ngwa — enweghị ngwanrọ a ga-etinye. ↗
home.02_registry_optional_blockchain_identity: 02 Registry Njirimara blockchain nhọrọ. Ndị nnọchi anya a ga-achọta, a ga-ebugharị, ma a ga-agba akaebe n'ofe A2A ma ọ bụ onye ahịa MCP ọ bụla. ↗
home.03_embed_web_component_one_tag_any: 03 Embed Ihe mejupụtara webụ <agent-3d>. Otu mkpado. Onye ọbịa ọ bụla. Ebugharị nwayọ, CSS dịpụrụ adịpụ, CDN na-akwado ya n'ụwa niile. ↗
home.04_pay_per_call_http_native_usdc: 04 Pay-per-call Obere ịkwụ ụgwọ USDC nke HTTP na-akwado. Kwụọ ụgwọ maka nkà, ozi, ma ọ bụ oge. 0% ụgwọ ikpo okwu n'oge beta mepere emepe. ↗
